Doubling Season.name: Doubling Season
Doubling Season.oracle_text:
If an effect would create one or more tokens under your control, it creates twice that many of those tokens instead.
If an effect would put one or more counters on a permanent you control, it puts twice that many of those counters on that permanent instead.

Collected Company.name: Collected Company
Collected Company.oracle_text: Look at the top six cards of your library. Put up to two creature cards with mana value 3 or less from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
Collected Company.flavor_text: Many can stand where one would fall.

Hopeful Eidolon.name: Hopeful Eidolon
Hopeful Eidolon.oracle_text:
Bestow {3}{W} (If you cast this card for its bestow cost, it's an Aura spell with enchant creature. It becomes a creature again if it's not attached.)
Lifelink (Damage dealt by this creature also causes you to gain that much life.)
Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has lifelink.

Branching Evolution.name: Branching Evolution
Branching Evolution.oracle_text: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on a creature you control, twice that many +1/+1 counters are put on that creature instead.
Branching Evolution.flavor_text: As Aclazotz's undead forces approached the temple of Ojer Kaslem, they met a roaring wall of vibrant, flourishing life.

Raging Goblin.name: Raging Goblin
Raging Goblin.oracle_text: Haste (This creature can attack and {T} as soon as it comes under your control.)

Renata, Called to the Hunt.name: Renata, Called to the Hunt
Renata, Called to the Hunt.oracle_text:
Renata's power is equal to your devotion to green. (Each {G} in the mana costs of permanents you control counts toward your devotion to green.)
Each other creature you control enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.

Cloudshift.name: Cloudshift
Cloudshift.oracle_text: Exile target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under your control.
Cloudshift.flavor_text:
"Clouds are made of water and air, so between the two of us, we ought to be able to bend them into any shape we want."
—Aang

Hardened Scales.name: Hardened Scales
Hardened Scales.oracle_text: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on a creature you control, that many plus one +1/+1 counters are put on it instead.
Hardened Scales.flavor_text:
"Naga shed their scales. We wear ours with pride."
—Golran, dragonscale captain

Temporary Lockdown.name: Temporary Lockdown
Temporary Lockdown.oracle_text: When this enchantment enters, exile each nonland permanent with mana value 2 or less until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
Temporary Lockdown.flavor_text: "Any one of us could be compromised," said Karn. "No one leaves until we know who can be trusted."

Zombify.name: Zombify
Zombify.oracle_text: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Zombify.flavor_text:
"The first birth celebrates life. The second birth mocks it."
—Mystic elder

Naturalize.name: Naturalize
Naturalize.flavor_text:
"And if you threaten me again, your shiny steel trousers will be sprouting daggerthorn vines."
—Iveta, rooftop runner
